title: Inspired by all the "Tiny cities" I made a "Tiny map" for Greek Mythology
author: Chilly5
selftext:
There's over 50 different little secrets in the map for fans of greek mythology to explore. Check it out here: [https://tinyodyssey.us/](https://tinyodyssey.us/)

This isn't a commercial project. Just a fun little side thing I thought was cool. Generated using Codex + Blender MCP using a technique known as "pixel splatting".

comments.author: Futfutfutfreestylo
comments.body: This is good! Reminds me of Civilization and Black & white.
